description:
Configure Screaming Frog SEO Spider to classify internal links based on their page location using the 'Custom Link Positions' feature. 

1. Go to Configuration > Custom > Link Positions.
2. Add the following 4 definitions using XPath:
   - Name: 'Header' -> XPath: //header
   - Name: 'Footer' -> XPath: //footer
   - Name: 'Sidebar' -> XPath: //div[contains(@class, "side_categories")]
   - Name: 'Main_Content' -> XPath: //div[contains(@class, "col-sm-8")]

3. Crawl https://books.toscrape.com/

4. After the crawl completes, export 'All Inlinks' to ~/Documents/SEO/exports/inlinks_by_position.csv.

5. Analyze the export and create a text report at ~/Documents/SEO/reports/link_distribution_report.txt listing the count of links found for each of your custom positions.
